srList.sentence: Inclusion criteria: phenotypical diagnosis of DS, aged >=30 years, and a stable dose of psychoactive medications (if any).
srList.title: Age

sentenceParts.c: Inclusion criteria: phenotypical diagnosis of DS, aged >=30 years, and a stable dose of psychoactive medications (if any).

srList.sentence: For IRR, the same interview was scored by two interviewers blinded to each others scores.

sentenceParts.c: For IRR, the same interview was scored by two interviewers blinded to each others scores.

srList.sentence: Statistics For population characteristics (Table 1), Pearsons chi-squared tests were applied to compare categorical data between groups.

sentenceParts.c: Statistics For population characteristics (Table 1), Pearsons chi-squared tests were applied to compare categorical data between groups.

srList.sentence: ANOVA tests were used to compare normally distributed continuous data (age and IQ-scores) between groups.

sentenceParts.c: ANOVA tests were used to compare normally distributed continuous data (age and IQ-scores) between groups.

srList.sentence: A Kruskal-Wallis test was used to compare the number of psychoactive medications between groups (categorial, not normally distributed). p-values are reported with three decimals.

sentenceParts.c: A Kruskal-Wallis test was used to compare the number of psychoactive medications between groups (categorial, not normally distributed). p-values are reported with three decimals.

srList.sentence: To compare individual item scores (frequency change and severity change) between the three groups, Kruskal-Wallis tests were used.

sentenceParts.c: To compare individual item scores (frequency change and severity change) between the three groups, Kruskal-Wallis tests were used.

srList.sentence: The effect of sex (malefemale) and depression (presenceabsence) were studied using Mann-Whitney U tests on the entire study group of 524 participants (regardless of dementia status).

sentenceParts.c: The effect of sex (malefemale) and depression (presenceabsence) were studied using Mann-Whitney U tests on the entire study group of 524 participants (regardless of dementia status).

srList.sentence: However, for analyses of frequency change and severity change per item and care burden change per section, the level of significance was adjusted according to the procedure described by Benjamini & Hochberg 37 to account for multiple testing.
